findings.fix: Lift eventually_differentiableAt / _right / _left to IsPiecewiseC1On (using its Finset breakpoint witness) and have the immersion inherit them via isPiecewiseC1On, so differentiability lives once at the weakest predicate.
findings.issue: eventually_differentiableAt (and its _right/_left corollaries, lines 219/225) are likewise stated only for immersions but their content is piecewise-C¹; they cannot be reused for a non-immersion piecewise-C¹ curve and form a parallel API alongside the existing piecewise-C¹ differentiability lemma.

summary: The four new differentiability lemmas use no immersion-specific content (non-vanishing tangent); they are immersion-specialized restatements of piecewise-C¹ differentiability facts that already exist as IsPiecewiseC1On.exists_countable_differentiableAt, re-derived through the immersion-only deriv_ne_zero_off_breakpoints instead of reusing the existing API.
